# Aegis

> A private, clinically rigorous coaching suite for executives and leaders:
> archetype exegesis, mood and decision analytics, habit architecture and
> confidential deep-dive reports.

Aegis pairs clinical assessment with daily practice. Each member works from a
personal archetype cartography, then sustains it through measured mood,
decision, habit and relationship tracking — with AI-assisted insight and
coach-authored deep-dive reports delivered privately in the app.

Aegis is invitation-only: accounts are created by coaches and administrators,
there is no public sign-up. The interface is bilingual (French / English).

## Pages
- [Home](/): The Aegis practice — positioning and entry point.
- [Sign in](/auth): Private access for existing members.
- [Newsletter](/newsletter): Public editions on archetypes, mental
  fitness and leadership.
